caption: The drawing features a wooden chest of drawers on tall legs, colored rich brown with realistic wood grain detailing. The chest consists of two sections: an upper section with five drawers arranged in three rows—two small drawers side-by-side at the top, below which are three full-width drawers—and a lower section with one long full-width drawer, making a total of six drawers. Each drawer has detailed, gold or brass-colored handles and ornate keyhole plates. The legs of the furniture are turned and spiraled, with six legs in total, and they are connected by curved stretchers near the base. The piece is rendered in three-quarter perspective, showing the front and right side, and is set against a plain, light background. No other objects or decorations are in the composition.
title: Highboy
